section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 24, Härnevi IP-Gånsta
section.notes: Runs from Härnevi IP north of Enköping to Gånstagården south of town, via Äsåsen, Enköpingsåsen, Enköping station area, parks and urban edge paths.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 24 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse raw GPX for the written Härnevi IP-to-Gånsta direction.
Preserve five segments; segments around Äsåsen/Äspuss appear to include branch or alternate-loop geometry.
Do not connect Etapp 24 directly to Etapp 25 unless the current route dataset confirms the Gånsta-Bredsand transition geometry.
qa: Computed segmented length is 18.183 km vs official 17 km, likely because the GPX includes branch/loop geometry.
Härnevi IP handoff from Etapp 23 is exact.

checks: All rows have source keys present in sources.

Shared Härnevi IP rows reuse verified object coordinates from Etapp 23 research.
Approximate rest-table rows are marked medium confidence.
Slinga 24:1 leakage and uncertain Etapp 25 handoff are suppressed/metadata.
Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and import/pending boundaries rechecked.
Iteration 5 final pass: source references, decision buckets, counts, dedupe readiness and mapdata drawability revalidated.
limitations: Most mid-route rest table coordinates need exact object or map verification.
Härnevi kyrka and Härnevi plantskola water require current/opening-season checks.
Etapp 25 handoff must be resolved before integration.

iterationLog.summary: Quality pass for Etapp 24: rechecked JSON structure, source references, GPX/mapdata drawability, declared counts and unsupported type risk against the full numbered Upplandsleden set.

iterationLog.summary: Integration/dedupe pass for Etapp 24: compared rows against adjacent and same-coordinate etapper to flag shared endpoints, repeated access metadata and route/loop leakage for later import consolidation.

nextIterationNeeds: Apply canonical dedupe groups during import rather than importing each section-scoped duplicate as a separate public facility.
